hero.label: Who We Are
hero.title: A Togolese nonprofit born from the communities it serves
hero.text: Founded on October 18, 1998 by young people from the Avé Prefecture who refused to accept the conditions they saw around them. Independent, non-political, and rooted in respect for local cultures.

mission.label: Our Mission
mission.title: Simple, urgent, and unwavering
mission.text: To support underprivileged children by giving them access to education and essential healthcare. To walk alongside vulnerable communities — providing prevention, awareness, and access to basic health services. To stand with girls and young women so they can improve their living conditions, find their place in society, and move forward with dignity, strength and hope.

values.title: Education as a Right
values.text: Every child deserves school access. Our family sponsorship programs ensure children don't just enroll — they stay, graduate, and go further.

values.title: Health as a Foundation
values.text: Without health, nothing else is possible. We set up social and health infrastructure to relieve suffering and meet the needs of local communities.

values.title: Partnership, Not Dependency
values.text: Our work is rooted in win-win partnerships where everyone contributes and benefits. The community leads; we walk alongside.

values.title: Girls First
values.text: Through vocational training, rights promotion, and capacity building — we support girls' integration into working life with dignity.

values.title: Economic Autonomy
values.text: Income-generating activities — sponsorship, agriculture, vocational training — help families fund their children's schooling sustainably.

values.title: Active Citizenship
values.text: Civic education and community awareness build communities that advocate for themselves and hold space for one another.

team_section.label: Our Leadership
team_section.title: The people behind the mission
team_section.text: A team rooted in the Avé Prefecture — leading APED's programs in education, health, WASH, and women's empowerment.

territory.label: Area of Intervention
territory.title: Avé Prefecture, Maritime Region of Togo
paragraphs: Our association works across approximately 1,146 km², home to nearly 120,000 people. This is where our actions come to life — close to the communities we serve.
Avé is divided into two municipalities across eight cantons. In each, live families, children, and young people facing multiple vulnerabilities. It is alongside them that we work every day.
